title: 20 January 1947 — Who Does the Assembly Represent?
summary: Rajendra Prasad defends the Assembly's representative character; the Steering Committee is organised and the Objectives Resolution debate resumes.

title: Representative character of the Constituent Assembly
summary: The President answers claims in the British Parliament that the December Assembly represented only one community and puts community attendance figures on record.

title: Rights must be enforceable by ordinary people
summary: The debate moves beyond listing rights to the practical problem of whether poor citizens can secure judicial protection against the State.
